name: apollo-ios
description: Private Capacitor iOS container for Apollo

scripts.ios:add: npm run build && cap add ios --packagemanager SPM
scripts.ios:sync: npm run build && cap sync ios
scripts.ios:build: npm run ios:sync && xcodebuild -project ios/App/App.xcodeproj -scheme App -configuration Debug -sdk iphonesimulator -derivedDataPath DerivedData CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO build
